question: Carcinoma of lip, EXCEPT
question_ar: جميعها صحيحة فيما يتعلق بسرطان الشفة باستثناء؟

options.text: 95% of lip carcinoma in the lower lip
Sun exposure and smoking are risk factors
More common in elderly white men
Radiation therapy is the treatment of choice
The majority presents as an ulcerative lesion

correct_text: Radiation therapy is the treatment of choice
